Expected cardinality is therefore data-determined - the number of comma-separated items actually present - and expected order is ascending copy number from zero; do not silently apply genotype-combination ordering. GT=|1/2|3') uses allele index 3 although ALT lists only two alleles, and row 3 ('chr20 15 . G C ... GT=1|2') uses index 2 although ALT lists one; row 3 is additionally self-contradictory, because with the leading indicator omitted and no '/' present VCF 4.4/4.5 make the first indicator implicitly '|' (phased), yet PSL='.,chr20*10*1' marks that allele unphased; and ploidy is inconsistent between rows 2 (three alleles) and 3 (two) for the same sample on the same CHROM.
